variables.name: target
variables.description: The literal answer to the main question: Will Kesha represent the US at Eurovision 2026?

variables.name: us_eligible_to_enter
variables.description: Binary: EBU rules/exception permit a United States entry (as a competing delegation) in the Eurovision Song Contest 2026 held in Vienna, per official eurovision.tv participant list published before the May 2026 contest.

variables.name: us_delegation_announced
variables.description: Binary: Any official announcement by EBU or a US broadcaster of a US act performing as a competing entry at Eurovision 2026, before the contest final.

variables.name: kesha_active_availability
variables.description: Binary: Kesha is publicly active (touring/releasing) and has not announced a hiatus, retirement, or scheduling conflict covering May 2026.

variables.name: kesha_eurovision_rumor_intensity
variables.description: Latent unitless hub for media/betting buzz linking Kesha to Eurovision 2026. 0 = no credible coverage (recent-normal), 1 = scattered fan speculation, 2 = mainstream outlets report talks, 3 = confirmed negotiations/leaks, 4 = official reveal.

variables.name: ebu_rule_change_shock
variables.description: Binary shock: EBU announces before May 2026 a rule change or special invitation allowing non-EBU-member/non-European countries such as the US to participate or feature as competing entries.

variables.name: kesha_interval_guest_slot
variables.description: Binary: Kesha appears at Eurovision 2026 only as an interval/guest performer or presenter rather than as a competing US entrant (would not satisfy 'represent the US').

variables.name: unlisted_shock
variables.description: Some other major disruptive event NOT named above (a shock outside the enumerated cases) materially moves the outcome before resolution.

requests: P(target = True | ebu_rule_change_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False)
P(us_delegation_announced = True | ebu_rule_change_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False)
P(us_eligible_to_enter = True | ebu_rule_change_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False)

variables.name: target
variables.description: The literal answer to the main question: Will Trump and Putin not meet?

variables.name: peace_process_momentum
variables.description: Latent hub: intensity of US-Russia diplomatic momentum toward a Ukraine settlement during June 7-30, 2026. Legend: -1 = talks collapsed/hostile rupture; 0 = recent-normal stalemate (sporadic envoy contacts, no summit planning); 1 = recent-high (active shuttle diplomacy, framework text under negotiation); 2 = severe/strong regime (ceasefire agreed, summit publicly under preparation); 3 = extreme (final peace deal signing scheduled with both leaders); 4 = unprecedented full normalization

variables.name: ceasefire_in_effect
variables.description: Binary: a formal Russia-Ukraine ceasefire or truce is in effect for at least 7 consecutive days at any point before June 30, 2026, per credible reporting

variables.name: summit_publicly_scheduled
variables.description: Binary: by June 30, 2026, the White House or Kremlin publicly announces a specific Trump-Putin in-person meeting with a date and/or venue

variables.name: days_remaining_window
variables.description: Number of calendar days remaining in the question window from resolution date (June 7, 2026) to June 30, 2026, in which a meeting could physically occur

variables.name: trump_health_capacity_shock
variables.description: Binary shock: Trump is incapacitated, removed, dies, or is otherwise unable to travel/meet before June 30, 2026

variables.name: escalation_rupture_shock
variables.description: Binary shock: major escalation event (new sanctions package plus Trump publicly calling off engagement, major Russian strike killing US/NATO personnel, or Kremlin refusal) that kills summit prospects before June 30, 2026

variables.name: unlisted_shock
variables.description: Some other major disruptive event NOT named above (a shock outside the enumerated cases) materially moves the outcome before resolution.

requests: P(target = True | trump_health_capacity_shock = False, escalation_rupture_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False)
P(summit_publicly_scheduled = True | trump_health_capacity_shock = False, escalation_rupture_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False)

variables.name: target
variables.description: The literal answer to the main question: Will the spot exchange rate of US dollars to UK pound sterling have increased by 2026-06-28 as compared to its value on 2026-06-21?

variables.name: gbpusd_pct_change
variables.description: Percent change in DEXUSUK spot rate from the value published for 2026-06-21 (or nearest prior business day, since 6/21 is a Sunday) to the value published for 2026-06-28 (or nearest prior business day, likely Friday 2026-06-26). Positive = pound stronger vs dollar.

variables.name: risk_sentiment_hub
variables.description: Latent global risk/dollar-demand intensity over 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-26. Legend: 0 = calm recent-normal week (VIX ~15, DXY moves <0.5%), 1 = elevated stress (VIX ~25, DXY +1%), 2 = severe risk-off regime (VIX ~40, DXY +2.5%), 3 = extreme/record crisis (VIX >60, DXY +4%). Negative values = unusually strong risk-on/dollar-selling week.

variables.name: us_uk_rate_spread_change
variables.description: Change in the 2-year US Treasury yield minus 2-year UK gilt yield spread over 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-26, in basis points. Positive = US yields rise relative to UK (dollar supportive).

variables.name: us_data_surprise
variables.description: Net US macro data surprise during the week (PCE/inflation, labor, sentiment releases 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-26), standardized: positive = stronger-than-expected US data.

variables.name: uk_fiscal_or_boe_shock
variables.description: 1 if a discrete UK-specific event during 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-26 (BoE communication surprise, fiscal/gilt market stress, political leadership crisis) moves GBP by more than 1% in a day; else 0.

variables.name: global_geopolitical_shock
variables.description: 1 if a major geopolitical/financial shock (military escalation, sovereign/credit event, major tariff action) occurs during 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-26 and drives a >1.5% single-day move in the dollar index; else 0.

variables.name: unlisted_shock
variables.description: Some other major disruptive event NOT named above (a shock outside the enumerated cases) materially moves the outcome before resolution.

requests: P(target = True | uk_fiscal_or_boe_shock = False, global_geopolitical_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False)
E[gbpusd_pct_change | uk_fiscal_or_boe_shock = False, global_geopolitical_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False]

variables.name: target
variables.description: The literal answer to the main question: Will the total dollar amount of mortgage-backed securities held by the US Federal Reserve Banks have increased by 2026-04-05 as compared to its value on 2026-03-29?

variables.name: weekly_mbs_change
variables.description: Change in WSHOMCB (Fed MBS holdings, millions USD) between the 2026-03-29-week value (H.4.1 Wednesday 2026-04-01 vs prior) and the 2026-04-05-week value (Wednesday 2026-04-08 release), i.e. value_next_week minus value_this_week, in millions of USD. Positive means increase.

variables.name: settlement_week
variables.description: 1 if the week ending Wednesday 2026-04-08 contains a major agency MBS TBA settlement / large forward-purchase settlement posting on the Fed balance sheet (historically mid-month, roughly one week per month shows a big step), else 0.

variables.name: monthly_prepay_runoff
variables.description: Average monthly principal paydown on the Fed's agency MBS portfolio in March-April 2026, in millions of USD per month (recent regime ~10,000-18,000).

variables.name: reinvestment_policy_on
variables.description: 1 if, as of April 2026, FOMC policy directs reinvestment of agency MBS principal payments into MBS (rather than into Treasuries or full runoff), per the effective Statement on Longer-Run Goals / Directive.

variables.name: policy_shock_balance_sheet
variables.description: Binary shock: FOMC or NY Fed announces between 2026-03-01 and 2026-04-08 a material change to agency MBS operations (e.g. active sales, resumed MBS purchases, or redirected reinvestment) that alters weekly MBS holdings dynamics.

variables.name: market_stress_shock
variables.description: Binary shock: acute financial-market stress episode (e.g. MOVE index above 160 or a funding/mortgage-market dislocation) between 2026-03-15 and 2026-04-08 prompting emergency Fed asset support.

variables.name: unlisted_shock
variables.description: Some other major disruptive event NOT named above (a shock outside the enumerated cases) materially moves the outcome before resolution.

requests: P(target = True | policy_shock_balance_sheet = False, market_stress_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False)
E[weekly_mbs_change | policy_shock_balance_sheet = False, market_stress_shock = False, unlisted_shock = False]

variables.name: target
variables.description: The literal answer to the main question: Will the average price of regular gas in the US have increased by 2026-02-08 as compared to its value on 2026-02-01?

variables.name: weekly_price_change
variables.description: Change in EIA/FRED GASREGW US regular gasoline retail price between the week ending 2026-02-02 (reported as 2026-02-01 value) and week ending 2026-02-09 (2026-02-08 value), in dollars per gallon. Positive means increase; target=1 iff this is strictly greater than 0.

variables.name: crude_oil_price_change
variables.description: Percent change in front-month WTI crude oil settlement price from 2026-01-26 to 2026-02-06 (lagged driver of pump prices).

variables.name: crack_spread_change
variables.description: Change in US Gulf Coast RBOB gasoline crack spread (gasoline futures minus WTI) between 2026-01-26 and 2026-02-06, dollars per barrel; reflects refinery outages and seasonal spring-blend transition.

variables.name: oil_supply_shock
variables.description: Binary: a discrete geopolitical/supply shock (OPEC+ surprise cut, Middle East/Russia conflict escalation, major sanctions action) occurring 2026-01-25 to 2026-02-06 that moves crude more than 5% in a day.

variables.name: refinery_outage_shock
variables.description: Binary: a major unplanned US refinery outage or severe winter storm curtailing >300 kb/d of refining capacity between 2026-01-25 and 2026-02-06 reported by trade press/EIA.

variables.name: seasonal_upward_drift
variables.description: Historical share of early-February weeks (first full week of Feb, 2010-2025) in which GASREGW rose week over week; used as base-rate seasonal tendency.

variables.name: market_risk_intensity
variables.description: Latent unitless energy-market disruption intensity over the window. 0 = recent-normal calm (crude moves <2%/wk, no outages), 1 = recent-high volatility year (crude ~5% weekly swings), 2 = severe regime (crude ~12% weekly move, major outage), 3 = extreme/record regime (crude >25% move, war/blockade), 4 = unprecedented.

variables.name: unlisted_shock
variables.description: Some other major disruptive event NOT named above (a shock outside the enumerated cases) materially moves the outcome before resolution.

variables.name: target
variables.description:
The literal answer to the main question: Will ON's market close price on 2026-04-05 be higher than its market close price on 2026-03-29?

Stock splits and reverse splits will be accounted for in resolving this question. Forecasts on questions about companies that have been delisted (through mergers or bankruptcy) will resolve to their final close price.

variables.name: semi_sector_risk_regime
variables.description: Latent unitless risk/sentiment intensity regime for semiconductor equities over 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-05. Legend: 0 = recent-normal calm tape (SOX weekly move within ±2%), 1 = elevated volatility (SOX weekly move ~±5%), 2 = severe risk-off (SOX weekly ~-10%), 3 = extreme crisis regime (SOX weekly ~-18%), -1 = strong melt-up (SOX weekly +8%).

variables.name: sox_weekly_return
variables.description: Percentage change in the PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOX) close from 2026-03-27 (or last close on/before 2026-03-29) to 2026-04-05 (last close on/before).

variables.name: on_weekly_return
variables.description: Percentage change in ON Semiconductor close price from 2026-03-27 (last close on/before 2026-03-29) to last close on/before 2026-04-05, per Yahoo Finance, split-adjusted.

variables.name: on_idiosyncratic_return
variables.description: ON-specific return component: on_weekly_return minus beta-adjusted SOX return over the same window.

variables.name: tariff_or_trade_shock
variables.description: 1 if a major new US/China/EU tariff, export-control, or trade action affecting semiconductors is announced between 2026-03-30 and 2026-04-05.

variables.name: on_company_specific_news
variables.description: 1 if ON Semiconductor issues material company-specific news (guidance revision, M&A, analyst-day, major design win/loss, ratings action moving stock >4% in a day) during 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-05.

variables.name: unlisted_shock
variables.description: Some other major disruptive event NOT named above (a shock outside the enumerated cases) materially moves the outcome before resolution.

requests: P(target = True | tariff_or_trade_shock = False, on_company_specific_news = False, unlisted_shock = False)
E[on_weekly_return | tariff_or_trade_shock = False, on_company_specific_news = False, unlisted_shock = False]

variables.name: synoptic_regime_hub
